key_insight: A well-balanced WE-PINN formulation exactly preserves lake-at-rest equilibria in its discrete residual, even over discontinuous bathymetry.
engineering_relevance: This mesh-free approach can model shallow-water flow over uneven beds without introducing residual imbalance at still-water equilibria.
method: Enforce weak space–time conservation on randomly placed, potentially overlapping control volumes without differentiating the network.
Integrate the geometric source by parts and correct local bed slopes so quadrature reproduces exact bed increments.
Use independent networks across bed discontinuities, coupled by conservation of discharge and total head.
evidence_signal: Four lake-at-rest tests achieved round-off residuals; seven bottom-step Riemann problems yielded relative L1 free-surface errors of 6.9×10⁻⁴–3.5×10⁻³ and recovered critical states without prescribing them.
watch_item: Exact residual balance does not guarantee rapid training convergence: reaching equilibrium to round-off required an extended training budget.
paper_title: Well-Balanced WE-PINNs for the Shallow Water Equations over Smooth and Discontinuous Bathymetries
